column1: # Hand labels for a closing measurement of the engineering-role classifier (issue #10, after iteration 12).
# They label 1000 rows drawn on 2026-09-24 from the corpus as iteration 11's rules classify it, reported
# in docs/measurements/engineering-role-2026-10-03.md, excluding every id held by an earlier fixture.
# Labelled on 2026-09-24 from docs/engineering-role-criterion.md alone, at revision
# 763ca057f6e352ce345756abfced1d4415f35581 (with the four criterion decisions for the close), over the
# bare cleaned titles, before any prediction was read.
# Labelled by a subagent denied the classifier's source, the iteration reports and the earlier label
# fixtures; it read the criterion and the sample and nothing else.
# This fixture is never regenerated: a session is not reproducible, so the labels are the artifact and
# not the process that made them.
# Families labelled under criterion readings a future revision might supersede:

# - Managers/directors over software work -> IN (Engineering Manager Frameworks, Director Applied AI, Head of Information Security, Manager of IT Consultants, OpenStack Engineering Manager). Managers over a software-ish word without clear engineering scope -> UNKNOWN/domain_ambiguity (Mission Director Cyber, Tech Support Manager, Manager of Web Experience). Engineering Manager CAPEX Projects, Manager Mechanical Engineering -> OUT.

# - Product managers (incl. Director of Product, Product Lead, PM Core Experience, Group/Staff PM, Product Management Consultant) -> UNKNOWN/scope_ambiguity, even with a software qualifier (Staff Product Manager Developer tools, Product Manager Auth0). Other product titles without a qualifier (Product, Product Internship, Product Specialist Productivity, Manager Product Operations, Product Insights Manager) -> UNKNOWN/domain_ambiguity. Product Designer, Head of Product Marketing -> OUT.

# - Program/project managers (Project Manager, Technical Project Manager, Lead TPM, Program Director, PMO, Hardware Engineering Program Manager) -> UNKNOWN/scope_ambiguity; but construction/clinical ones (Construction Project Manager Intern, Project Manager Industrial Construction, Clinical Project Manager, Data Center Construction PM) -> OUT.

# - Sales/solutions engineers and solution/implementation/professional-services consultants (Sales Engineer New York City, Outside Sales Engineer, Solution Consultant, Implementation Consultant, Professional Services Consultant) -> UNKNOWN/scope_ambiguity. Solutions Architect (EMEA Startups, EDW Migrations) -> IN. Customer Solutions Consultant -> OUT (generic head). GTM Engineer, Applied Value Engineer, Director Value Engineering -> domain_ambiguity.

# - Vendor packages: developer/engineer roles on a package -> IN (Guidewire Engage Developer, SFMC Engineer, Salesforce Commerce Cloud SFRA Developer, Low Code Engineer SFMC). Functional consultant/analyst roles on a package -> scope_ambiguity (NetSuite Consultant, Lead SAP PP DS Consultant, IT Functional Analyst SAP, Oracle EBS SLA SME).

# - AI-training gig posts: OUT when the named expertise is non-software (Data Entry Clerk AI Training, Linguist Translator AI Training, Chemistry Graduates AI Training, Doctors AI Training, AI Trainer Serbian); IN when the named expertise is software (Javascript Developers AI Training, Computer Sciences Graduates AI Training, Database Administrator Graduates AI Training). Survey/research-study participant posts -> OUT (not a vacancy).

# - Analysts: market-marked analysts -> domain_ambiguity per the Treasury Analyst rule (FP&A Analyst, EDD Analyst, Credit Risk Analyst, Analyst Investment Banking, Revenue Operations Analyst). Business/data/product/BI analysts -> scope_ambiguity (Business Analyst II, Staff Data Analyst, Product Analyst, Analyst Business Intelligence). Security/IT analysts -> IN (SOC Analyst, IAM Analyst, Analista de Aplicaciones, Analista de sistemas). Discipline analysts -> OUT (BCBA, Actuarial Analyst, Staff Propulsion Analyst).

# - Engineers with an ambiguous domain -> domain_ambiguity (Staff Engineer, Quality Engineer, Project Engineer, Research Engineer, Deployment Engineer, Staff Reliability Engineer, Test Engineer Alarms, Design Engineer); named hardware disciplines (GNC, RF, propulsion, HV power, PDK, signal integrity, controls for manufacturing) -> OUT.

# - IT support/ops -> IN (Technical Support Engineer, Service Desk Technician, Helpdesk Technician, Service Desk Engineer, Directory Services Engineer); Customer Support Engineer, Product Support Engineer -> domain_ambiguity. Building Engineer, Field Service Technician -> OUT.

# - Designers, researchers and scientists: UX/service/product/graphic designers, UX researchers, UX writer -> OUT; Research Scientist Autonomous Systems, Applied Scientist, Quantum Scientist, Scientist I -> domain_ambiguity; lab/biology scientists and Computational Biologist/Chemistry -> OUT. Titles with no readable head (Intern, Strategist, Intercedent STEM, Data Validation Liquidity, Director MOE, Research Lead Training) -> unruled.
